name: Pampering
overview: Scripture warns against excessive indulgence in pleasure and pampering, showing that love of pleasure and luxury, such as wine and rich food, leads to poverty and shame (Proverbs 21:17; 23:20; 28:7). The careful nurturing of servants in comfort can lead to unintended consequences (Proverbs 29:21), and even the pursuit of personal joy apart from godly priorities is ultimately fleeting (Ecclesiastes 2:10). Believers are instead called to store up treasures in heaven rather than earthly pleasures that decay and are stolen (Matthew 6:19).
